On-Orbit Demonstration Mission aimed at validation of a new generation of star trackers.
Description

On-Orbit Demonstration Mission aimed at validation of a new generation of star trackers. The program is co-funded by the European Commission through Horizon 2020 SME Instrument.

PAYLOAD: Multicamera system for spacecraft autonomous attitude determination by means of star observation.
Notes

Tyvak website left an impression that it will be separate 6U CubeSat, but the star tracker flew on D-Orbit ION.
